newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-SFE wheat futures still firm against US trend.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-SFE wheat futures still firm against US trend.

text.p: Australian wheat futures continued to firm on Friday with near term contracts trading up by 50 cents-A$1.00 a tonne.
March 1997 added A$1.00 to A$171.00 with five lots traded while May 1997 rose 50 cents to A$172.00 a tonne in five trades.
Ben Suttie of C,A & L Bell Commodities Corp Pty Ltd, who traded the five March contracts, said the deals were spreads.

The Australian Wheat Board's pool price, increased by A$4.00 to A$192.00 a tonne for Australian Standard White, remained the most important factor in the market and explained why Australian wheat futures held up while U.S. futures fell, he said.
